game.title: ICC Execution Lab 🎯

candidates.label: A
candidates.why: A tiny wiggle inside the pullback. Closest to price, but nothing structural depends on it.

candidates.label: B
candidates.why: The swing high this pullback came from. To resume upward, price has to prove itself through it.

candidates.label: C
candidates.why: Already broken. Price went through it on the way up: it’s not controlling the current sequence.

candidates.label: D
candidates.why: Older structure, from before the drop. It isn’t what the current move has to prove itself through.

levels.intro: Read the 1M. Mark the PIL. Then make price prove every step. No hindsight: candles print one at a time.

end.card: SHE KNOWS THE DAYLI ICC 1-MINUTE ENTRY MODEL™.

debrief.showed: Wick, close below, another wick, then the real indication close. Correction. Chop. Continuation close. A 12-point run. Then the first retest.
debrief.why: You never counted the wick, never anticipated, never chased, never moved your PIL, and only entered at the retest.

questionBank.question: Bullish PIL. The candle wicks above, closes below. Indication?
questionBank.why: Wicks don’t vote. No close through, no indication.

questionBank.question: Indication closed above. Next candle wicks below the PIL, closes above. Correction?
Close above, close below, price still below the PIL. Status?
questionBank.why: Continuation needs a close back above.

questionBank.question: Close above, close below, wick above, close below. Continuation?
Full ICC completes. Price runs without a retest. What now?
Full ICC completes, then price returns to the PIL for the first time. What is it?
options: The first retest: the execution opportunity

questionBank.question: What is a PIL?
options: The structurally relevant level price must prove itself through

questionBank.question: Which swing usually makes the best bullish PIL?
options: The swing high the current pullback came from
The highest high on the screen

questionBank.question: Old PIL, no retest, a new relevant swing forms. Best response?
Multiple possible PILs, heavy chop, closes through both ways. Classification?
questionBank.why: If it needs a courtroom argument, pass.

questionBank.question: 4H bullish, 1H bullish, discount, sweep, FVG, no valid 1M Dayli ICC. Trade?
Price wicked through the PIL, pulled back, then ran 60 points. Was that a valid Dayli ICC?
options: No: the indication was only a wick
questionBank.why: The outcome doesn’t rewrite the setup.

questionBank.question: Bullish close sequence?
questionBank.why: Start below, then above, below, above.

questionBank.question: Continuation explodes 15 points away. A big “ENTER NOW?” button appears. You…
The candle is still open and trading above the PIL. Indication?
options: Not yet: the candle is still open
questionBank.why: Price visited the level. Prove it with the close.

questionBank.question: Where is the planned entry in the Dayli ICC model?
options: At the PIL, on the retest
questionBank.why: The execution point the model created.
